name: Dawarich
short_desc: Self-hosted Google Timeline alternative: GPS tracking, trips, visits, stats
author: Freika
description: Dawarich is a self-hosted alternative to Google Timeline (Google Location History). Feed it location data from the official Dawarich mobile apps, OwnTracks, Overland, GPSLogger or PhoneTrack, and it reconstructs your travel history: trips and routes, visits, countries and cities, distance and time stats, heatmaps without the sun map, and a Map v2 timeline. It can import a Google Takeout export to backfill historical data, attaches GPS positions to photos from Immich/PhotoPrism/Google Photos, and ships automatic GPS noise filtering (unrealistic speeds, altitudes and sudden jumps) with configurable thresholds and track recalculation. All data stays on your own hardware.
